QuestInfo.name: Hearts of Perion
QuestInfo.0: #rManji#k wants to talk to you about the #rincreasing number of golems#k.
QuestInfo.1: Manji says that the golems are being driven by the spirits of Perion's warriors! Collect #bWarrior Hearts#k from #rAncient Mixed Golems#k for #rBlackbull#k in the #bTribal Refugee Camp#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #rWarrior Hearts#k to #bBlackbull#k and completed the memorial ceremony for the Perion warriors.

0.0: I think I know why the golems are causing us so much trouble. The #rspirits of Perion's warriors#k have stuck around after that final battle. Take the #bWarrior Hearts#k back from the #rAncient Mixed Golems#k, and return them to #bBlackbull#k.

yes.0: #bBlackbull#k can finally lay the warriors of Perion to rest... but he'll need #b25 Warrior Hearts#k for the ceremony.

no.0: You didn't gather the Warrior Hearts? I thought you'd understand them.

1.0: You need something?\r\n#L0##bI brought the hearts of Perion's greatest warriors.#l\n#k
1.1: You can't have my heart! I am #ba great Perion warrior#k, and my spirit and heart are my own! Who do you think you are?!\r\n#L0# #bNo, I'm not here for your soul. I BROUGHT back the hearts of Perion's warriors to put them to rest!#l\n#k

yes.0: Oh, you should learn to communicate. Sure, I'll hold the memorial service. We were all #rbrothers#k, after all...
yes.1: They will all have a peaceful sleep in a dream that will never end. It would've been nice if it wasn't a dream from the start... But what can we do? We're already in a dream.
yes.2: But now it'll be better. At least we won't fall into a deeper nightmare. And it's all because of you. Thanks.

item.0: Would you like to hear my story?
